scopes.philosophy_and_religious_studies: Combined major; time, remission and postgraduation plans

time: Defined doctoral-program start can include a same-field master degree at the doctoral institution or a prerequisite master degree; exact time-item response count is not printed.
remission: Question A7 asks about full or partial tuition remission. Not a living stipend or guaranteed funded duration; exact item response count not printed.
support: Questions A38/A39 concern educational and living expenses across all graduate degrees, including master and doctorate; primary is largest total source.
debt: Question A40 concerns education-related money owed at doctorate receipt. Published medians exclude zero-debt respondents. Not federal-only loan disbursements.
commitments: Definite employment includes new employment or returning to predoctoral employment; not a first-job probability. Postdocs are separate.
missing: D is suppressed; - is not calculable. Item nonresponse and unreported graduation status are not zero outcomes.
